**Finding: COMPLIANT (preferred position met).**

The agreement imposes no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching restriction on Sanofi. Searches across the full document for "solicit", "hire", "employ or engage", "induce … to leave", "recruit", "employee", and "personnel" surfaced only incidental uses (FTE definition, solicited committee input, confidentiality recipients, availability of RevMed technical personnel under manufacturing/supply, and the debarment covenant), and a complete read of the General Provisions article confirms no restrictive covenant. Because our preferred position is that Customer bears no non-solicit at all, no redline is proposed.
